fixed_bad_cases: valid assignment totals no longer imply all other task requirements passed
unknown user, revenue, release-date and device facts are stated as unknown
transient provider failures and documented empty JSON content receive one bounded retry
provider traces use safe error codes and never store response bodies or credentials
limitations: This is one fixed-set regression run, not a production accuracy claim.

No real-user efficiency or business outcome has been measured yet.
